create_autotrain_project: create an AutoTrain project by submitting a form with task type, base model, hardware, and dataset files
fetch_model_choices: fetch available model choices for a given task like text classification or image classification
fetch_task_params: fetch UI parameter definitions for a given task and param type like basic or full
stop_training: stop all running training jobs by killing their associated processes
fetch_logs: fetch training logs with GPU device memory usage information from the autotrain log file
